title: Disulfiram Alleviates Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis in Mice via Inhibiting Aurora Kinase A and Restoring Autophagy.
snippet: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) is a severe, progressive liver disease lacking effective therapies. Disulfiram (DSF), an FDA-approved medication for alcohol dependence, exhibits diverse biological activities beyond its primary indication.
